text.p: Grow Biz International Inc said Friday it is comfortable with analysts' earnings estimates of $0.41 per share for all of 1996.
Grow Biz President and Chief Executive Officer Ronald Olson told Reuters that the company is also comfortable with estimates of $0.70 per share for 1997.
For all of 1995, the company, which franchises stores that sell used and new consumer goods, reported earnings of $0.28.
"Our stock is close to 20 times our earnings level, and I don't see why we would not continue at 20 times earnings," Olson said.
Grow Biz stores sell sporting goods, children's clothing, personal computers, compact discs and musical instruments.
Shares of Grow Biz were trading unchanged at 8-3/4.
